title: OutOfMemory

review.reason: A 2020 Graphite wgpu-0.5 render-pipeline failure caused by a shader sampler misuse; the reporter confirmed the fix and Varve uses ADR-0003's renderer policy (Canvas2D default, opt-in WebGPU/WebGL2 with Canvas2D fallback), so an unsupported or failing GPU backend cannot abort startup.
review.varveAssessment: Touches only the @varve/compositor backend-selection path, which already degrades to Canvas2D.

title: How to contribute?

review.reason: A project-community onboarding question answered on Discord, with no product behaviour described. It depends on Graphite's contributor process, which Varve does not inherit.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; Varve has its own CONTRIBUTING.md and docs portal.

title: Support the Layout data type so the content variable can be passed

review.reason: Depends on Graphite's retired native GUI layout DSL (passing a Layout-typed content variable between XML components); Varve's interface is React/CSS and has no such layout data type.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; there is no custom GUI component language to extend.

title: Initialize window layout by composing components within one another from the root window component

review.reason: Composing parsed XML GUI components into a DOM-like window tree for Graphite's custom native UI engine, which was shelved when Graphite moved to a web frontend. Varve's UI tree is React components.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; React already provides component composition and reactive prop propagation.

title: Implement layout algorithm

review.reason: A layout algorithm (fixed/inner/percent/free-space sizing) for Graphite's shelved XML GUI widget system, closed with that system. Varve's document layout is separate and already built as @varve/layout.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; document flex/grid layout lives in @varve/layout and widget layout is CSS.

title: Enforce standard Rust code formatting

review.reason: Formatting is enforced rather than agreed by convention: cargo fmt and Biome run through `just format`/`just gate` and Tier 0 of `pnpm verify:affected` formats and lints touched files, with pre-commit hooks as the backstop.
review.varveAssessment: No new work; the Rust formatting gate already exists in the validation pipeline.

title: Extract layout attributes into a separate structure

review.reason: Extracting layout attributes into a typed structure for Graphite's custom XML GUI parser, including its `on:click` event-binding attributes. Varve has no such parser or attribute vocabulary.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; component props are TypeScript types, not a parsed layout DSL.

title: Better GUI code error reporting

review.reason: Compiler-style error reporting (codespan) for Graphite's custom GUI component XML parser. That parser was shelved, and Varve authors UI in TypeScript where tsc/Biome already report errors.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; there is no GUI component DSL to diagnose.

title: Implement scrolling with hidden overflow

review.reason: Adds a `scroll` layout attribute and shader-level clipping to Graphite's custom GUI layout engine; that engine was shelved. Varve's panels use CSS overflow, so the attribute has no analogue.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; overflow and clipping are CSS concerns in the React shell.

title: Add an opacity attribute for elements to be drawn translucently

review.reason: Requests an `opacity` layout attribute so a custom-rendered GUI component can be composited translucently with its children. Varve composites DOM/CSS widgets with group opacity, so no layout-engine attribute is needed.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; translucency of UI surfaces is plain CSS opacity.

title: GUI overlay layer(s)

review.reason: The goal is drawing tooltips, dropdowns and modals above the base window layer. Varve renders those through FloatingPortal and OverlayRegistry (documented in the popover system) with Escape and light-dismiss ownership, rather than a hand-built GUI layer renderer.
review.varveAssessment: Overlay/shell surfaces already exist; no renderer-level layer system is required.

title: Scripting Language: What about WASM instead?

review.reason: A design discussion about using WASM-instead-of-JS for user-authored GUI component code in Graphite's custom UI stack. Varve has no scriptable GUI component API or plugin GUI runtime.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; Varve has no user scripting surface for interface code.

title: Use `log` instead of `println`

review.reason: The request is to replace temporary debug println! calls with a leveled logging facade. Rust modules still contain println! call sites (for example crates/varve-accel/src/effects.rs and varve-print/src/lib.rs), but the packet gives no evidence whether those are legitimate CLI/test output or stray debug prints, so each site needs an audit.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect Rust logging discipline across crates; no confirmed user-facing impact.

title: Upgrade wgpu to 0.7.0

review.reason: A dependency bump inside Graphite's 2021 render crate, closed without being done. Varve pins and upgrades its own wgpu through varve-accel under ADR-0237, so there is nothing to port.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; wgpu versioning is owned by varve-accel.

title: Code review existing GUI language parsing/AST/component generation code and architecture

review.reason: A code review of Graphite's GUI language parser/AST files and terminology, shelved with that system. Varve has no equivalent files to review.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Unite web build systems (WebPack for WASM bindings and Vue CLI for frontend)

review.reason: Unifying Graphite's Vue CLI frontend build with its WebPack wasm-bindgen build. Varve uses pnpm + Vite with React and has no Vue/WebPack stack to unite.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; the build is already single-pipeline.

title: Design the render engine architecture

review.reason: Architecture kickoff for Graphite's node-based render engine, closed in favour of a vector-only 0.1. Varve is direct-manipulation with IR replay and has no node graph to architect.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; the render architecture is settled in ADR-0001/ADR-0003.

title: Might want to consider optimizing for speed instead of optimizing for code size

review.reason: Graphite-internal wasm build-profile tuning (opt-level size vs speed), closed without a decision and with no described user-facing defect. Varve's WASM artifacts have their own pinned baseline/SIMD build.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; there is no reported problem to fix.

title: Rename core lib crates to have 'graphite' prefix

review.reason: A crates.io publishing/naming policy for Graphite's internal packages. Varve's crates are already namespaced (varve-core, varve-engine, ...), so this is packaging hygiene with no user-facing behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Fix inconsintent use of spaces and tabs

review.reason: Whitespace/indentation is enforced mechanically: rustfmt and Biome run in `just format` and in the affected gate (Tier 0 on touched files), with pre-commit hooks preventing inconsistent spacing from landing.
review.varveAssessment: No new work; formatting is a hard gate already.

title: Implement the Tool State Machine

review.reason: Proposes per-tool finite state machines authored in a custom text format plus a grammar and parser for them. That FSM DSL is a Graphite-internal architecture Varve does not have; Varve's tools are direct pointer handlers over BaseTool and InteractionContext.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; tool behaviour is already implemented without an FSM definition format.

title: Layer system for SVG elements in the document

review.reason: The request is a layer stack with folders, selectable shapes and incremental re-render instead of regenerating SVG strings. Varve's scene model has frames/groups/layers with a LayersPanel, shared selection, and IR replay with dirty-rect redraws.
review.varveAssessment: The layer system and incremental redraw already exist.

title: Active Tool Router and stub for Tool State Machine

review.reason: The deliverable was routing pointer input to whichever tool is active. Varve does this through the tool registry plus canvas/toolDispatcher.ts, which dispatches normalized input to the active BaseTool implementation.
review.varveAssessment: Active-tool input routing already exists; only the stubbed FSM glue is Graphite-specific.

title: Proc macro for deriving Hint trait

review.reason: A Rust proc macro that derives Graphite's internal Hint trait for tool-state hints. Varve has no Hint trait, no derive macro, and no generated hint data.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Question: Collaboration

review.reason: Asks whether live multi-client collaboration is planned. Varve ships real-time collaboration as authoritative semantic-operation rooms (crates/varve-room plus the app-hosted host, ADR-0243) with presence, compensating shared-session undo and viewer-side mutation rejection.
review.varveAssessment: Collaboration already exists end to end.

title: Eliminate wasm-pack from build system

review.reason: The concern was an unmaintained, vulnerable wasm-pack in the 2021 build. Varve still builds WASM with wasm-pack but pins it (0.13.1) and installs it through a verified CI step, which is the mitigation Graphite itself settled on when it closed this as keep-wasm-pack.
review.varveAssessment: Build-tool supply-chain risk is already pinned and verified; removal is optional.

title: Implement the Path Tool for Bezier curve editing

review.reason: Asks for a point system, on-canvas point/handle visualisation and Bezier editing. Varve has pen/pencil/path tools with node editing (corner/smooth/bend) and handle overlays drawn with the renderer camera transform.
review.varveAssessment: Path/node editing already exists; the Blender-style distance-to-edge point prioritisation would be an optional refinement, not evidenced either way.

title: Add caching for rendered svg shapes

review.reason: Regenerating all SVG strings every frame was the cost being removed. Varve does not render via SVG strings: the engine emits IR replayed in a render worker, with SubtreeReplayCache and partial dirty-rect redraw so unchanged subtrees are not re-rendered.
review.varveAssessment: Per-frame full regeneration is already avoided by the render pipeline.

title: Tools interrupted in their drag phase break when returning to the tool

review.reason: A drag interrupted by switching tools left stale tool state, so returning to the tool drew extras. Varve's BaseTool has a cancel path (pointercancel/Escape) and workspace switches resolve in-progress interactions, but tool-switch-mid-drag teardown is not evidenced and would need a canvas E2E check.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas tool-state cleanup (packages/editor/src/tools) is the affected area; a regression test would confirm or close it.

title: The app is blocked

review.reason: The report is that document tabs cannot be closed and the File/Edit/Document menus open but do nothing; the thread attributes it to unimplemented UI. That is the same finding as the general polish task for signalling unimplemented UI, so it carries no separate work.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the button/disabled-reason work assessed under #196.

title: Change Ellipse Tool to work like a standard ellipse tool (not just circles)

review.reason: The request is ellipse-from-corner with Shift constraining to a circle and Alt drawing from the centre. Varve's EllipseTool already documents exactly that behaviour (drag to size, Shift=circle, Alt=from-centre).
review.varveAssessment: Tool behaviour already matches the request.

title: Node graph-based viewport overlays system

review.reason: Tools need to draw overlays above the canvas (selection boxes, hover hints, gradient and path handles). Varve draws these in dedicated overlay components such as SelectionOverlay, guides and warp handles using the same camera transform as the renderer.
review.varveAssessment: Overlay rendering exists without a node graph; a per-type enable/disable toggle is not evidenced and would be a small UI addition if wanted.

title: Document scaling

review.reason: Document units plus pan/zoom/rotate and viewport-to-canvas projection helpers. Varve has a camera model in packages/shared/src/viewport.ts and canvas/cameraState.ts with rotation-aware screenToWorld/worldToScreen used by tools and overlays.
review.varveAssessment: Camera and coordinate projection already exist and are the shared contract.

title: Refactor input system

review.reason: Asks for input handling where modifiers and pressed buttons are tracked globally, survive focus loss, and behave consistently on non-US layouts (Neo Shift/CapsLock). Varve owns input in canvas/inputPipeline.ts, but neither focus-loss modifier reconstruction nor keyboard-layout normalisation is evidenced in the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Editor input pipeline would be the affected area; needs a targeted keyboard-state review.

title: The Pen Tool adds a layer when it is completed after only creating the starting point

review.reason: Committing the pen tool after only the starting click created a 0x0 layer that polluted the layer panel. Whether Varve's pen tool rejects single-anchor/zero-size paths at commit is not evidenced and would need a canvas interaction check.
review.varveAssessment: Pen tool commit validation (packages/editor/src/tools) is the affected area.

title: Standardize icon folders

review.reason: Asks for a fixed icon-size taxonomy (12/16/24) organised into folders. Varve sources icons from @varve/ui components (Lucide Icon / Phosphor SolidIcon) plus canonical app SVG masters in packages/ui/src/icons and generates platform assets, so there is no per-size icon folder set to standardise.
review.varveAssessment: Icon sourcing is already centralised and generated.

title: Update CSS with recent changes to colors in the UI design

review.reason: Keeping stylesheets in sync with design colours by hand is replaced by tokens: packages/ui color.ts generates tokens.css and `pnpm audit:tokens` gates WCAG-AA pairs across three themes plus undefined-token and literal-fallback usage.
review.varveAssessment: Colour drift is already prevented by the generated token pipeline and its audit.

title: Fully populate the Document Panel UI

review.reason: The body is only 'Blocked on #203.' with no described scope, and the item was closed without a resolution note. No specific Varve gap can be mapped from the packet, even though Varve has an inspector/context-bar surface.
review.varveAssessment: Cannot be mapped without the original scope; would need the referenced blocker for context.

title: Plumb tool options from the Document Panel's options bar to the tool

review.reason: Keavon explicitly merged this into #114 ('Merging into #114'), and both describe the same tool-options round trip to the backend. The plumbing request has no independent scope.
review.varveAssessment: Covered by the tool-options wiring assessed under #114.

title: Populate the Document Panel's options bar with tool settings based on the active tool

review.reason: Wanted tool options in the options bar driven by the active tool rather than per-tool hard-coding. Varve composes the context bar from WorkspaceConfig.toolbar via composeToolbar with tools/toolRegistry.ts as the single source for labels, icons, order and shortcuts.
review.varveAssessment: Active-tool-driven options already exist through the toolbar/context-bar composition.

title: Add the Escape and RMB inputs as ways to cancel the in-progress shape drag

review.reason: Asks for Escape and right-click to abort an in-progress shape drag (with pen committing instead). Varve's shared BaseTool exposes a cancel hook documented as being called on pointercancel or Escape, so every tool inherits abort behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: Cancellation is already a shared tool contract; per-tool right-click mapping would be a small check.

title: Make the show/hide layer button work

review.reason: Make the layer panel's show/hide control actually update layer visibility state. Varve's scene model supports hidden and locked nodes and the LayersPanel toggles them through document operations, not a one-way UI switch.
review.varveAssessment: Layer visibility already round-trips through the document state.

title: Layer panel does not update after undo

review.reason: The layer panel kept a stale copy after undo and only refreshed on the next add. Varve renders the panel from the single immutable Document held in editor state, so undo re-renders from the new document and there is no cached panel copy to go stale.
review.varveAssessment: The single-document-state invariant prevents this class of stale-panel bug.

title: Build the document journal (history chain)

review.reason: Asks for a Git-like document journal with navigation. Varve has @varve/history: an append-only operation log with a revision DAG, snapshots and recovery, which backs undo/redo and persistent revisions.
review.varveAssessment: History is already DAG-based and persistent.

title: Change how Vue sends input to the backend

review.reason: Wants input routed from the UI framework into the engine with viewport-only mouse capture, drag-outside continuation, focus-loss reconstruction, wheel support and standardised key names. Varve keeps input in canvas/inputPipeline.ts and toolDispatcher.ts rather than a framework binding, but the specific robustness cases (focus loss, stylus/pen input) are not evidenced.
review.varveAssessment: The input pipeline is the affected area; a focus-loss and pen-input review would settle it.

title: Hitbox for popover dependendent on browser zoom

review.reason: Popover hitboxes drifted with browser zoom because the UI was drawn and hit-tested by the renderer. Varve's popovers are real DOM elements positioned by Floating UI through FloatingPortal/OverlayRegistry in CSS pixels, so zoom cannot desynchronise the hitbox.
review.varveAssessment: The popover system already avoids renderer-based hit testing.

title: Make tools use primitive vector shape generator nodes

review.reason: Requires tools to emit primitive vector generator nodes into Graphite's node graph, explicitly blocked on the node-graph work. Varve has no node graph; tools create scene nodes directly.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; shape tools already produce real scene geometry.

title: Build dropdown menu widget

review.reason: Asks for a dropdown menu widget. Varve has menubar menus, the @varve/ui Select component (native select elements are banned) and a Popover primitive, so dropdowns are shared components rather than per-feature markup.
review.varveAssessment: Dropdown surfaces already exist as a shared system.

title: SVG export

review.reason: Save the current document as SVG. Varve's export pipeline writes SVG (alongside PDF/PNG) and @varve/codegen produces SVG/React/Flutter/SwiftUI output.
review.varveAssessment: SVG export already ships.

title: Layer selection (and multi-selection) in the Layer Panel

review.reason: Click and Shift-click layer selection with a selected visual state, reported to the editor. Varve's LayersPanel supports single and multi-selection (selection scrub, selection sets) and shares that selection with the canvas and commands.
review.varveAssessment: Layer multi-selection already exists.

title: Add context menus using menu lists

review.reason: Add context menus built from menu lists. Varve has canvas and page context menus (menu/canvasContextMenu.ts, layerContextMenu.ts) driven by the same menu definitions as the menubar and command palette.
review.varveAssessment: Context menus already exist; radial menus were only a future idea in the thread.

title: Deleting layers

review.reason: Delete/Backspace removes the selected layers. Varve registers layer deletion as an editor action with undo support, reachable from the layers panel, menus and shortcuts.
review.varveAssessment: Layer deletion already exists.

title: Select Tool: Viewport layer click selection

review.reason: Click a shape in the viewport to select its layer. Varve hit-tests through the engine (hitTest policy with tolerance and geometry tests) and selects the corresponding scene node.
review.varveAssessment: Viewport click selection already exists.

title: Drag to rearrange layers in the stack

review.reason: Drag layers within the stack with an insertion indicator. Varve's LayersPanel implements drag and drop through useLayersDnD plus layerDropResolver/layerMovePlan, including drop targets and auto-expand.
review.varveAssessment: Layer drag-reordering already exists.

title: Handle multiple documents

review.reason: Support multiple documents open at once with document tabs. Varve tracks documents as sessions with tabs, per-session dirty state, recovery points and lifecycle coordination.
review.varveAssessment: Multi-document sessions already exist.

title: Select Tool: Grab/drag selected layers around viewport

review.reason: Grab and drag the selection around the viewport, selecting the layer under the cursor when nothing is selected. Varve implements this in its selection/transform tooling (FloatingTransformTool, selection operations) as a core direct-manipulation behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: Dragging selections already works; the extra 15-degree constraint and grid snap are refinements.

title: Tracking Issue: Graphene engine development

review.reason: The Graphene engine tracking issue, enumerating migration from legacy layers to a node graph. Varve has no node graph and does not intend to adopt Graphene's model.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; post-MVP tracking moved on to #2350 in Graphite itself.

title: Select Tool: Viewport box selection

review.reason: Box-select a region and select shapes whose geometry actually intersects it, not merely those whose bounds overlap. Varve selects through engine geometry hit testing and ships marquee plus lasso selection (LassoTool/lassoGeometry).
review.varveAssessment: Geometry-based marquee selection already exists.

title: Feed the Properties panel with editable layer-specific parameters

review.reason: Feed a properties panel with editable layer-specific parameters. Varve's Inspector exposes geometry, fills/strokes, effects, masks and layer settings through shared @varve/ui controls.
review.varveAssessment: The inspector already covers layer properties.

title: Standardized layout definition system

review.reason: Wants a Rust-generated JSON specification for laying out panel widgets so the backend can describe UI. Varve builds panels as React components over @varve/ui primitives, so there is no serialized widget-layout format to standardise.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected; UI layout is not produced by Rust.

title: Tool refactoring to reduce code duplication

review.reason: Reduce duplication between tool implementations, including shared modifier/pressed-key state. Varve centralises this in BaseTool plus InteractionContext and the tool registry, so tools share input and state handling.
review.varveAssessment: Shared tool infrastructure already exists.

title: Add folders in the Layer Tree panel of the frontend

review.reason: Add folders to the layer tree so nested documents can be shown. Varve's groups/frames are real nested scene nodes and LayersPanel renders the tree with expand/collapse and flat-tree navigation.
review.varveAssessment: Hierarchical layer display already exists.

title: Adapt frontend for responsive layout at smaller window sizes

review.reason: Adapt the editor to small windows without scrollbars, including tool-shelf capacity. Varve keeps the shell a CSS Grid and governs toolbar capacity with retention-ordered overflow (toolbarRetention) and a sticky More control instead of scrollbars.
review.varveAssessment: Responsive shell and toolbar overflow already exist.

title: Unify bounding box for shapes during creation

review.reason: Unify the bounding box used while drawing a shape with the one used after commit, honouring centre/aspect modifiers. Varve computes tool previews and committed geometry from the same node geometry model, with modifier handling in the shared tool layer.
review.varveAssessment: One geometry/bounds model is already shared between preview and commit.

title: New Tool: Fill Tool

review.reason: Change a clicked layer's fill to the working colour, with raster flood fill as a later goal. Varve treats fills as first-class paint attributes (multiple fills/strokes per object, editable in the inspector) and ships raster paint tools.
review.varveAssessment: Fill editing already exists as an attribute workflow; a dedicated click-to-fill tool is not required.

title: New Tool: Text Tool

review.reason: Create a text layer on click and edit it in place, including CJK and cursor placement. Varve has a full text pipeline (shaping, BiDi, CJK, vertical writing, text on path) with text editing in the canvas.
review.varveAssessment: Text authoring already exceeds the requested MVP.

title: Full Eyedropper Tool implementation based on pixel sampling

review.reason: Sample colours from the artwork into the working colours. Varve ships an EyedropperTool (packages/editor/src/tools/EyedropperTool.ts) with unit tests, using canvas pixel sampling instead of DOM element guessing.
review.varveAssessment: Eyedropper sampling already exists.

title: New Tool: Navigate Tool

review.reason: A navigate tool plus modifier-based pan/zoom/rotate across all tools. Varve has the HandTool and a camera model with rotation-aware transforms, along with zoom and modifier navigation shortcuts.
review.varveAssessment: Navigation already exists and is shared by all tools.

title: Write about Sprint 4 in the Rust Gamedev newsletter for May 2021

review.reason: Writing a Rust Gamedev newsletter entry about Graphite's sprint. It is project promotion, not product behaviour, and has no Varve equivalent.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Make the color picker functional

review.reason: Make the colour picker set the working colours instead of only drawing swatches. Varve has functional colour controls backed by its colour pipeline (varve-colour with ICC/Oklab) and document colour variables.
review.varveAssessment: Colour selection already works end to end.

title: Show working color modifications in the frontend

review.reason: Swap/reset working colours changed backend state without informing the frontend. In Varve working colours live in editor state that the UI renders from, so a swap re-renders every consumer without a message to plumb.
review.varveAssessment: The single-state architecture removes this class of desync.

title: Choice of a linear algebra library

review.reason: A dependency-selection discussion (glam vs nalgebra) for Graphite's Rust math layer. Varve's vector/camera maths lives in its own shared geometry and viewport modules, so no external linear-algebra decision is inherited.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Fix security vulnerability in wasm-pack dependency

review.reason: An upstream patch to wasm-pack's vulnerable sub-dependency, blocked on that project's maintainer. It is third-party build tooling maintenance, not Varve product behaviour; Varve pins and verifies its wasm-pack install.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Write about Sprint 5 in the Rust Gamedev newsletter for June 2021

review.reason: A Rust Gamedev newsletter entry about Graphite's sprint. Project promotion with no product behaviour or Varve equivalent.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Contextually reactive user input hint system

review.reason: Wants the status bar to list the interactions currently available, derived from tool state, selection and keybindings. Varve derives displayable shortcut labels from the binding registry (workspaceShortcutLabel/toolShortcutLabel) and has a status bar, but a reactive availability list is not evidenced.
review.varveAssessment: Status bar plus shortcut registry are the affected area; whether a reactive hint list exists needs a UI check.

title: Add `:active` CSS accent color for button clicks throughout frontend and design

review.reason: Wants a distinct pressed/accent colour for buttons. Varve routes every button through @varve/ui Button/IconButton/ToggleButton with token-driven interaction states and a closed variant vocabulary enforced by ButtonVariantParity tests, so pressed styling is a token decision rather than ad-hoc CSS.
review.varveAssessment: Button interaction states are already centralised; Graphite later closed this as unnecessary.

title: Multi-column tool shelf

review.reason: The underlying problem is tool-shelf capacity in narrow windows. Varve addresses it with retention-ordered toolbar overflow and a sticky More control that never collapses the active or recovery tools, rather than a resizable two-column shelf.
review.varveAssessment: Tool reachability is already handled; a multi-column shelf is an alternative mechanism, not a gap.

title: Fix the tab bar so tabs get clipped when they overflow beyond the bar and allow scrolling

review.reason: Tabs should clip and remain reachable when they overflow the tab bar. The body is empty, and how Varve's document-session tab strip behaves under overflow (clip, scroll, or shrink) is not evidenced in the packet.
review.varveAssessment: The document tab strip in the shell would be the affected area; needs a many-document UI check.

title: Improve the project readme

review.reason: Rewrite an out-of-date, overlong readme into an approachable overview with a roadmap. Varve maintains README.md plus the docs tree, and `pnpm audit:docs` enforces index/link/drift correctness on current-state documentation.
review.varveAssessment: Documentation upkeep is already a maintained, audited surface.

title: Transparency loss when setting working colors from Rust

review.reason: Setting working colours from backend code dropped their alpha to 100 percent. Varve's colour model carries alpha, but whether the swap/reset working-colour path preserves it is not evidenced and is exactly the round trip that failed here.
review.varveAssessment: Colour state and the swap/reset actions are the affected area; needs an alpha round-trip check.

title: Build a console

review.reason: Wants a Blender-style console that echoes executed actions and accepts typed commands, for discoverability and headless use. Varve covers typed/discoverable commands through the command palette and headless work through @varve/cli, but an echo console surface is not evidenced.
review.varveAssessment: Command palette, @varve/cli and @varve/history operation logging are the closest existing surfaces; a console UI would be a new surface.

title: Create a warning that Safari is unsupported

review.reason: Wants an unsupported-browser gate that explains why and lets the user continue anyway, motivated by a BigInt64Array requirement. Varve's browser demo ships its own WASM artifacts, but whether it detects and declines capability-limited browsers is not evidenced.
review.varveAssessment: Would affect the web demo bootstrap (apps/desktop build:try / public demo), not the desktop app.

title: Add options bar widgets for tools to control tool behavior

review.reason: Wants per-tool option widgets in an options bar wired to the backend. Varve's context bar hosts tool-specific options, composed from the active tool via composeToolbar and tools/toolRegistry.ts, with the inspector as the complete editor.
review.varveAssessment: Tool options UI and routing already exist.

title: Implement the Pen Tool for Bezier curve creation

review.reason: Implement the pen tool for Bezier creation. Varve's pen tool creates and extends Bezier paths, paired with the path/node editing described for the companion path-tool request.
review.varveAssessment: Pen tool authoring already exists.

title: Populate the Properties Panel with SVG shape properties

review.reason: A stopgap properties panel for shape fill, stroke and stroke width. Varve's inspector already edits fill/stroke paints (including multiple fills per object), stroke width, geometry and effects.
review.varveAssessment: Shape property editing already exists in the inspector.

title: Hook up Opacity and Blend Mode layer settings

review.reason: Hook opacity and blend mode widgets to layer state, including mixed values across a selection. Varve's scene model carries blend mode and opacity on paints/layers (BlendMode in the scene package) and applies them in the compositor, editable from the inspector.
review.varveAssessment: Both attributes already exist as layer/paint state.

title: Placing bitmap images in the document

review.reason: Place bitmap images in the document by drag or paste so they can be composited with vector/text. Varve imports bitmaps as document nodes (bitmap import, image mask coordinates, image trace and upscaling all operate on them).
review.varveAssessment: Bitmap placement already exists.

title: Duplicate the selected layers

review.reason: Ctrl+D duplicate of the selected layers, with copy/paste as a later question. Varve exposes duplicate as an editor action (including Repeat Duplicate on Ctrl+Shift+D) and clone operations that remap internal ids.
review.varveAssessment: Layer duplication already exists with id remapping.

title: Refactor Vue input components with `v-model` to support input and output

review.reason: Refactor Vue input components to use v-model for two-way binding with the Rust backend. It is Vue-specific UI plumbing; Varve is React/TypeScript and has no Vue component layer.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Design and build a website for the project

review.reason: Build a landing page describing the project. Varve has apps/website, an Astro static site with a documented GitHub Pages deploy (docs/release/website.md).

review.varveAssessment: Contributor documentation already exists and is audited.

title: Tracking Issue: Announce Graphite to the world

review.reason: A tracking issue for announcing the product to the world, including press, trailers and community posting. It is launch marketing, not a product behaviour or capability.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve path affected.

title: Add support for dragging the boundaries between panels

review.reason: Drag the gutters between panels to resize them. Varve's shell is a dock layout with draggable splitters (workspace/dock/dockGeometry, useEditorDockGeometry, dockSplitters in Shell.tsx), and the geometry persists per workspace.
review.varveAssessment: Panel resizing already exists.

title: Rearrange and dock tabs and panel groups in the editor workspace

review.reason: Rearrange and dock tabs and panel groups, which the thread notes is complicated by multiple documents and active-document message routing. Varve has a dock system (workspace/dock with dock operations and tests) plus per-workspace layouts, and tracks documents as addressed sessions rather than one implicit active document.
review.varveAssessment: Docking and per-workspace layout already exist.

title: Polish the editor by clarifying to users when UI elements aren't implemented yet

review.reason: Wants a standardised way to tell users that a control exists but is not functional. Varve's button/action system routes every action through @varve/ui Button with an explicit disabledReason for non-obvious blockers, a closed variant/size vocabulary enforced by tests, and a documented button-action contract.
review.varveAssessment: Unavailable-action signalling is already a system contract.

title: Boolean operations between shapes

review.reason: Union/subtract/intersect etc. on selected shapes, which the thread notes Kurbo does not provide. Varve has a boolean operations module over path geometry, invoked as an editor operation rather than a node graph.
review.varveAssessment: Boolean path operations already exist.

title: Alignment operations between shapes

review.reason: Align multiple selected layers left/centre/right/top/middle/bottom. Varve registers alignSelected('left'|'centerH'|'right'|'top'|'centerV'|'bottom') in createActionHandlers and exposes it in the Object menu.
review.varveAssessment: Alignment commands already exist.

title: Flip shapes operator

review.reason: Flip selected layers horizontally and vertically. Varve registers setSelectedFlipH/setSelectedFlipV as actions wired to the Object menu's flipH/flipV entries.
review.varveAssessment: Flip commands already exist.

title: Add an alignment/snapping system to the Select Tool

review.reason: Show alignment guides and snap while dragging layers near other layers' edges or centres. Varve implements snapping and guides (tools/snapping.ts, sticky snap, isometric snapping) and draws the guides through the overlay layer.
review.varveAssessment: Snapping and alignment guides already exist.

title: Nudge the selected layers around the canvas with the arrow keys

review.reason: Arrow keys nudge the selection by one canvas pixel, Shift by ten. Varve's nudgeController.ts implements arrow-key nudging with a Shift large-increment path, and menu/nudgeCapability gates when nudging is offered.
review.varveAssessment: Keyboard nudging already exists.

title: Indent expand arrow with child layers

title: Set mouse cursor in the viewport based on tool state

review.reason: Tools declare their pointer cursor through BaseTool.cursor(state), which ToolManager applies for the active tool and modifier state, covering zoom, pan/grab and crosshair drawing cases.
review.varveAssessment: Tool cursor handling in BaseTool/ToolManager.

title: Refresh the design of the Layer Tree panel

review.reason: LayersPanel is its own component with rows, colour tags, a bulk-action bar and node previews, so the layer tree is already a dedicated designed surface.
review.varveAssessment: LayersPanel design; nothing to refresh.

title: Path Tool: allow dragging handles, not just anchors

review.reason: NodeEditTool hit-tests anchors and direction handles separately (nodeEditGeometry), so dragging a handle moves that handle instead of the nearest anchor.
review.varveAssessment: NodeEditTool handle interaction.

title: Fix floating menus above scrollable content and respect their content's preferred width at edges of screen

review.reason: Varve's Popover is built on FloatingPortal plus Floating UI, which portals out of scroll containers and flips/shifts against the viewport edges instead of being clipped.
review.varveAssessment: Popover/FloatingPortal positioning.

title: Code cleanup and refactoring throughout the project

review.reason: A list of Graphite-internal Rust and Vue cleanup commits with no behavioural requirement; Varve is a separate codebase with nothing to port.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Path Tool: Select and modify multiple anchor points at the same time

review.reason: NodeEditTool keeps a selectedAnchors set with extend/range selection and moves every selected anchor together, covering both requested behaviours.
review.varveAssessment: NodeEditTool anchor selection.

title: Clean up the Rust codebase to reduce technical debt

review.reason: A list of Graphite Rust technical-debt commits without a behavioural ask; nothing in Varve corresponds to those changes.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Children of folders, when both are selected, move at double the transformation

review.reason: Varve treats only the selected root as the transform unit for bounds and movement (snapping excludes descendants because their bounds move with the selected root, and isometricSnapping asserts descendants are never moved twice), so a selected folder and its child are not double-transformed.
review.varveAssessment: Selection transform/bounds handling in SelectTool and snapping.

title: Redesign node icons

review.reason: LayersPanel and the toolbar render a per-node-kind icon set from @varve/ui, so the layer/node icon language the issue asks to design already exists.
review.varveAssessment: Layer icon set in LayersPanel/@varve/ui.

title: Send the viewport state info to the widgets when document loaded/switched

review.reason: Varve's context/options bar reads live editor and camera state from React context, so loading or switching a document needs no backend message round-trip to refresh widget values.
review.varveAssessment: Context bar and editor state synchronisation.

title: Change the mouse cursor to 'grabbing' when holding MMB and moving mouse on the canvas

review.reason: ToolManager owns middle-button panning and applies the active tool's cursor spec, including the grabbing cursor during a pan (middlePan tests).
review.varveAssessment: ToolManager pan/cursor handling.

title: Draw new shapes into the selected folder

review.reason: New shapes and text are parented into the selected container using frame/group parenting rules (frame-parenting and text-node-parenting tests), which is the deepest-common-parent behaviour requested here.
review.varveAssessment: Shape insertion parenting in the tool/frame code.

title: Turn the Select Tool's bounding box into a transformation cage

review.reason: SelectionOverlay exposes resize and rotation handles (HANDLE_KEYS includes 'rotation') with per-handle cursors, all computed with the renderer's world transforms.
review.varveAssessment: SelectionOverlay transform cage.

title: Implement the Crop Tool for resizing the artboard

review.reason: CropTool and PageTool cover drawing new page/artboard bounds, resizing existing ones and deleting them.
review.varveAssessment: CropTool/PageTool page-bounds workflow.

title: Implement the Gradient Tool

review.reason: GradientHandleOverlay provides draggable start/end handles on the canvas and GradientEditor edits stops for linear, radial and conic gradients.
review.varveAssessment: GradientHandleOverlay and the Inspector gradient editor.

title: Implement the Freehand Tool

review.reason: The pencil tool (registry id 'pencil') is Varve's freehand polyline tool, the direct equivalent of the requested Freehand Tool.
review.varveAssessment: Pencil tool in toolRegistry.

title: Implement the Spline Tool

review.reason: Varve's tool registry has no spline tool: the pen tool places independent anchors and node editing smooths them, but nothing fits a curve through a series of clicked points.
review.varveAssessment: Pen/node-edit tool family (toolRegistry, NodeEditTool).

title: Changing fonts with the Text Tool

title: Allow a filled polyline to be a draggable shape

review.reason: Hit-testing runs against filled path geometry, so a filled polyline is draggable anywhere inside its fill, not only along its line.
review.varveAssessment: Engine hit-testing for filled paths.

title: Prevent "Coming Soon" dialog from showing on sub-menu entries

title: New Document dialog

title: Setting pivot of rotation/scale in the transform cage

title: Populate and clean up menu bar entries

title: Add "New Group" and "Delete Layer" buttons to Layer Tree panel

review.varveAssessment: LayersPanel actions.

review.reason: The design work is for a Transform node inside Graphite's node graph, which the maintainer marked duplicate of #1530; Varve has no node graph or node-based transform semantics.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected; transforms are direct-manipulation properties.

title: Allow moving objects on mobile devices

review.varveAssessment: Gradient geometry/transform handling.

review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

review.varveAssessment: Undo/history interaction with the pen tool.

title: Preview fonts

title: Convert shape's stroke into a filled shape

review.varveAssessment: Polygon/star shape creation.

review.varveAssessment: SVG import parser in @varve/import.

review.varveAssessment: Bitmap export path.

review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Drag vector handle onto its anchor should hide them and make the anchor sharp

review.reason: Varve's node editing exposes corner/smooth handles, but the packet gives no evidence on whether dragging a handle onto its anchor collapses it and flips the node to corner.
review.varveAssessment: NodeEditTool handle collapsing / node sharpness.

title: Snapping to vector edges/curves

review.reason: Snap target collection includes finite layout segments and edge/centre lines (targetFeature 'segment' and 'edge' in snapping.ts), not just points.
review.varveAssessment: Snapping targets.

title: Improve FloatingMenu CSS so it stays with its parent scroll

review.reason: Floating UI's autoUpdate recomputes popover position on scroll and resize through FloatingPortal, so panels are not left behind when their parent scrolls.
review.varveAssessment: Popover positioning.

title: Switch from Vue to Svelte

review.reason: A framework migration from Vue to Svelte; Varve is a React application by design, so the migration has no counterpart.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Prototype the packaging of Graphite into Tauri

review.reason: Varve is already a Tauri 2 desktop app with the native Rust engine behind the same facade as the web build.
review.varveAssessment: Desktop packaging (apps/desktop, src-tauri).

title: Node graph frontend with stand-in data

review.reason: A node-graph frontend prototype with stand-in data; Varve has no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Boolean operations where shapes do not intersect

review.reason: Varve computes boolean operations (union/subtract/intersect/exclude) geometrically, and the result does not depend on the operands overlapping.
review.varveAssessment: Boolean operations module.

title: Viewport zoom/rotation while snapping doesn't show the snapped values

review.reason: Varve's zoom/rotation readouts derive from the live camera transform, and the camera does not snap zoom or rotation, so a displayed value cannot diverge from what is rendered.
review.varveAssessment: Camera/status-bar readouts.

title: Crash when Properties panel changes before input widget is sent to backend

review.reason: Depends on Graphite's backend-owned input widgets and widget-ID message ordering. Varve's Inspector controls are client-side React and submit values through editor operations, so a disposed widget cannot receive a late update.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Move Document Mode, Layer Tree panel's options bar, and tool shelf buttons from Vue to Rust

review.reason: Moving Vue-defined panel layouts into Graphite's Rust layout-definition system; Varve has no Rust-defined layouts.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: [Crash Report] Crash on undo Boolean operation

review.reason: Varve's history session keeps a selection journal keyed by revision and restores it on undo, so undoing a boolean operation cannot leave the selection pointing at removed nodes.
review.varveAssessment: History selection restoration (editorHistorySession).

title: Refactor the fragile way floating menus measure themselves and handle opening/closing

review.reason: Popover placement and measuring are delegated to Floating UI plus FloatingPortal rather than hand-measured offsets, so there is no fragile open/close measurement code to refactor.
review.varveAssessment: Popover/FloatingPortal implementation.

title: Clean up frontend folder structure and naming conventions of TypeScript files

review.reason: A Graphite-internal frontend file and naming cleanup with no behavioural requirement.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Refactor MenuList so its entries don't use the ref property

review.reason: Depends on Vue's ref-augmented MenuListEntry type and the :ref callback hack. Varve's menubar is a React component over action definitions with no ref passing between menu entries.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Move font loading from per-document to global on the editor

review.reason: Fonts are owned by the engine font registry and cached for the application (restoreStoredFonts), with documents referencing fonts rather than embedding them per document.
review.varveAssessment: Font registry/loading.

title: Move initialization from api.rs to the Editor backend

review.reason: Moving api.rs initialization calls into a single backend Editor message; Varve has no Rust api.rs/frontend message bootstrap.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve workflow affected.

title: Support multiple panel instances and documents at once

review.reason: The work is a refactor of Graphite's monolithic `document_message_handler.rs` and per-panel Svelte message subscriptions so viewport settings live on each panel instance. Varve has no equivalent message-bus/panel-handler architecture (React contexts, one canvas per session), so there is no subsystem to restructure.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve panel or render path is affected; multiple views of one document would be a new feature, not this refactor.

title: Remove direct DOM manipulation from Vue codebase wherever possible

review.reason: Framework-specific cleanup for Graphite's Vue components, which set inline styles through `ref`s and `querySelector`/`closest`. Varve's UI is React with component state and stylesheets, so the Vue DOM-ref idiom does not exist here.
review.varveAssessment: Nothing in Varve's React UI is affected.

title: Fix Interacting in GUI with text tool

review.reason: Graphite sent mouse-down messages whenever the mouse-button bitflags changed, so clicking in panels re-entered the canvas tool. Varve binds pointer handlers to the canvas element and starts text editing only from canvas hit-testing or the explicit `startTextEditing` action, so panel clicks cannot spawn text nodes.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas input routing and text-tool entry (`inputPipeline.ts`, `TextEditOverlay`).

title: Move "About Graphite" dialog build metadata acquisition from Webpack to Rust

review.reason: Moves Graphite's About-dialog build-metadata acquisition from a Webpack define into its Rust backend. Varve builds with Vite/pnpm and has neither the Webpack metadata injection nor Graphite's Rust frontend-message plumbing.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve build script or About dialog is affected.

title: Nudging layers isn't working

review.reason: Arrow-key nudging exists as `commands/nudge.ts` (`planNudge`/`planNudgeRepeat`) driven by `CanvasNudgeController`, with configurable small/big steps and one undo entry per held-key gesture.
review.varveAssessment: Nudge command and its shortcut path.

title: Graphite IndexedDb error: DOMException: A mutation operation was attempted on a database that did not allow mutations.

review.reason: The failure is Firefox's IndexedDB bug plus a missing startup message; the packet's ask is to degrade gracefully and tell the user. Varve's `RecoveryManager` keeps the session usable when a privacy policy blocks IndexedDB, and `@varve/crash` owns crash and recovery reporting.
review.varveAssessment: Persistence fallbacks in `packages/editor/src/recovery.ts` and the crash layer.

title: Implement the File > Import menu

review.reason: Varve ships a File > Import entry (`menu.file.import`) backed by the `@varve/import` parsers for SVG/PDF/PSD/AI/EPS/Sketch/bitmap, with an import report rather than a silent paste.
review.varveAssessment: Import menu entry and parser pipeline.

title: Hover outline doesn't pan with document

review.reason: Varve requires every overlay drawn over artwork to use the renderer's camera transform (`screenToWorld`/`worldToScreen`), so hover and selection outlines pan with the document instead of staying viewport-fixed.
review.varveAssessment: SelectionOverlay and guide overlay transforms.

title: Implement the Edit > Paste menu

review.reason: Copy and paste are shared editor commands: workspace invariant 6 makes them identical in every workspace, and the Edit menu exposes them through the same action registry as the shortcuts.
review.varveAssessment: Edit menu and shared clipboard commands.

title: Exporting bitmap images does not appear to work

review.reason: The report shows two defects: a downloaded SVG with an unbound `xlink:` prefix and a `blob:` image href, plus raster export that silently did nothing. The packet does not show how Varve's SVG and bitmap export embed image data, so applicability is unconfirmed.
review.varveAssessment: Export path would need checking for embedded-image references in SVG and raster output.

title: [Crash Report] Switching documents with different layer selections causes crash

review.reason: Varve keeps document, selection, viewport and dirty state per session in `state.sessions[]`, so switching documents swaps the whole session instead of reusing another document's selection.
review.varveAssessment: Session and document switching state.

title: Provide a way for multiple systems to subscribe to message broadcasts

review.reason: Asks for a broadcast subscription system in Graphite's backend dispatcher so events such as `DocumentIsDirty` reach multiple subscribers. Varve has no dispatcher or broadcast layer; consumers subscribe to React context state.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Export dialog option to set background color

review.reason: An export-dialog background choice with format-specific rules (transparent unsupported for JPG, a painted rectangle for SVG), closed in Graphite as low value once artboards had background colours. The packet does not describe Varve's export background options.
review.varveAssessment: Export dialog options and background emission for raster/SVG output.

title: Points/segments/shapes vector selection mode

review.reason: `NodeEditTool` treats anchors, handles and segments as distinct hit kinds with additive multi-select over `selectedAnchors`, covering point- and segment-level selection; whole-object selection stays with the Select tool.
review.varveAssessment: Path node-editing selection model.

title: Fix broken keyboard shortcuts

review.reason: Bindings live in the shortcut registry (`ShortcutManager` plus `registerEditorActions`) and File > Open (`menu.file.open`) is registered there rather than hard-coded per menu entry.
review.varveAssessment: Shortcut registry and File menu binding.

title: Reduce message spam to the Layer Tree's options bar widgets

review.reason: About re-sending the Rust-built widget layout for the Layer Tree options bar on every viewport click or drag frame in Graphite's layout transport. Varve's panels are React components reading editor state directly; no widget layout is serialized per frame.
review.varveAssessment: None; Varve has no Rust-to-JS widget-layout transport.

title: Modifying the transform of a zero-area layer causes a crash

review.reason: The crash came from dividing by a zero-area bounding box when scaling or rotating. Varve clamps width and height in the Inspector (`PositionSizeSection`) to a 1px minimum, so a zero-area scale or NaN rotation is not reachable from the properties panel.
review.varveAssessment: Inspector size fields and transform planning.

title: Update text live as it's typed in the Text node's properties panel field

review.reason: Text edits run through the text edit session and overlay, which re-shape and re-layout on each change and coalesce history entries, so the canvas reflects typing live instead of waiting for a commit.
review.varveAssessment: Text editing session, overlay and Inspector text field.

title: Nudge selected artboards with arrow keys

review.reason: Nudge plans operate on the current node selection, and frames and pages are ordinary nodes, so nudging a selected artboard moves the artboard rather than the artwork inside it.
review.varveAssessment: Nudge command and its selection scope.

title: Disable mouse stray when dragging on color picker overlay

review.reason: Varve's popover contract dismisses on an outside press or Escape through `OverlayRegistry`; pointer travel away from the trigger does not close the picker, so dragging inside a colour picker cannot dismiss it.
review.varveAssessment: Popover and colour-picker dismissal.

title: Zero-area artboards are confusing and impossible to deal with

review.reason: The packet's fix is a 1px minimum on artboard dimensions plus a way to find artboards. Varve clamps W/H in the Inspector and lists pages in the Pages panel, so an invisible zero-area page cannot become unselectable.
review.varveAssessment: Inspector size clamp and Pages panel.

title: Alter behavior of dragging unselected layers through selected layers

review.reason: Varve hit-tests on pointer-down and selects the topmost node under the pointer, then only starts a move for nodes in the current selection, so an unselected occluding layer is selected and dragged instead of the selected layer behind it.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas hit-testing and Select tool drag start.

title: Layer selection history

review.reason: Feature request to page through selection history with the Forward/Backward mouse buttons. The packet gives no evidence that Varve records selection history or maps mouse buttons 4 and 5.
review.varveAssessment: Selection state and input pipeline would need history tracking.

title: Process messages in a stack-based order

review.reason: Proposes call-stack ordering inside Graphite's message dispatcher instead of a single linear queue. Varve dispatches through React state and explicit command calls rather than a queue of messages.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Improve Path tool layer and anchor point selection behavior

review.reason: `NodeEditTool` supports additive anchor selection, isolates the clicked anchor when Shift is not held, and clears the anchor selection on empty-canvas clicks; the owning layer is selected by entering node editing on it.
review.varveAssessment: Path tool node-edit selection.

title: [Crash Report] unwrap on an `Err` value: LayerNotFound...

review.reason: The residual defect named in the final comment is history spam, where every mouse move during a handle drag became its own history entry. Varve wraps a gesture in `beginTransaction`/`commitTransaction`, so a drag lands as one undo entry.
review.varveAssessment: Undo/redo transaction boundaries and engine transform lookups.

title: Convert the 24 NudgeSelectedLayers keys into a shorter loop

review.reason: The packet closes this as a duplicate of #248: 24 near-identical `NudgeSelectedLayers` input-mapper lines should become a loop. Varve generates bindings through the shortcut registry and a shared nudge planner rather than an unrolled table.
review.varveAssessment: No unrolled nudge key table exists in Varve.

title: Extend welcome screen button click area to labels

review.reason: Varve's Home/welcome actions use the `@varve/ui` `Button` component, whose whole surface (icon plus label) is one hit target instead of an icon-only click area.
review.varveAssessment: Home surface and shared Button component.

title: Replace hint Rust -> JS data with a widget layout

review.reason: Wants Graphite's recursive hint structs replaced by its Rust-defined widget-layout system. Varve has no Rust-defined widget layout sent to the frontend; UI is React components over a TypeScript menu model.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Refactor the "actions" system into a unified and capable "commands" system

review.reason: Refactors Graphite's write-only action messages into stateful commands with dynamic parameters, quick favourites and hints. Varve has no action-message pipeline to rebuild; its `ActionRegistry` already carries id, validity with `disabledReason`, shortcut and menu placement.
review.varveAssessment: Graphite-internal; Varve's registry covers registration but not post-hoc parameter editing.

title: Switch event handling from event.key to event.code

review.reason: Varve resolves shortcuts through `input/physicalKey.ts`, which derives keys from `KeyboardEvent.code` (`Digit1`, `NumpadAdd`, ...) so layout and Shift/Option do not change which binding matches.
review.varveAssessment: Shortcut and canvas key matching.

title: Replace shortcut_requires_lock system with an alternate keybind when not locked

review.reason: Depends on Chromium's Keyboard Lock API in a browser tab; the alternate keybinding exists only for that fullscreen key-lock limitation. Varve's primary shell is the Tauri desktop app, which has no browser key-lock constraint.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve binding-display path is affected.

title: Restructure editor codebase to align with message hierarchy

review.reason: Restructures Graphite's editor modules to mirror its message hierarchy so rustdoc can be generated and hosted. Varve's packages and crates are already modular and have no message-hierarchy tree to align with.
review.varveAssessment: No Varve subsystem is affected.

title: Use heuristics for converting from keyboard input JS API to locale-tailored key code

review.reason: The packet's own resolution is a heuristics layer for locale-dependent keys. Varve resolves layout-independent physical keys in `physicalKeyFromEvent`/`physicalDigit`, shared by the shortcut registry and the canvas key handler, including numpad and NumLock cases.
review.varveAssessment: Keyboard layout handling shared by shortcuts and canvas input.

title: Saving, updating, and reading files from disk

review.reason: Varve saves and opens documents through the `@varve/platform` abstraction (Tauri filesystem on desktop) with autosave recovery points kept separate from the saved file; the web File System Access API path is not required for the desktop product.
review.varveAssessment: Platform save/open and recovery persistence.

title: [Crash Report] Drawing an artboard on a finite canvas

review.reason: Caused by zooming against a zero-size viewport, which produced NaN and then a non-finite transform panic; fixed in Graphite by the message-ordering change in #750. The packet says nothing about Varve's camera and non-finite guards.
review.varveAssessment: Camera math and finite-transform guards in `packages/shared/src/viewport.ts` and `cameraState.ts`.

title: Extend path segments with the Pen tool

review.reason: The pen tool extends an in-progress path by adding segments and closing the path, with nullable per-anchor handles, which is the behaviour requested.
review.varveAssessment: Pen tool path construction.

title: Draw an overlay for the origin point of the selected layer(s)

review.reason: Obsoleted in Graphite by #525's pivot UI. Varve's SelectionOverlay derives transform handles from the node's document-space geometry through the same camera transform, which is the superset of a separate origin marker.
review.varveAssessment: SelectionOverlay and transform handling.

title: Alt-drag should duplicate layers

review.reason: `SelectTool` starts a `duplicate-drag` gesture when Alt is held on pointer-down, so Alt-drag duplicates the selected nodes instead of moving them.
review.varveAssessment: Select tool drag gesture.

title: Key repeat from modifier keys causes message spam and dropped frames

review.reason: Modifier state is read from each pointer event (`shiftKey`/`altKey`) rather than streamed as messages, and held arrow keys are coalesced by `CanvasNudgeController` into one transactional gesture, so key repeat cannot spam a message channel.
review.varveAssessment: Input pipeline modifier handling and nudge repeat.

title: Replace legacy layer types with nodes

review.reason: Converts Graphene's `LayerDataType` structs into `/node-graph` nodes, blocked in the thread on Document Graph work. Varve's scene nodes are a fixed enum tree, not a graph.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Rotating object via property panel eliminates shear

review.reason: Reports that editing rotation in the properties panel drops an existing skew, and the thread notes skew/rotation/scale combine awkwardly in the affine. The packet does not establish whether Varve's Inspector rotation preserves non-orthogonal transform components.
review.varveAssessment: Transform model and the Inspector rotation field.

title: Implement the Document Graph

review.reason: Implements Graphite's user-facing Document Graph over its Proto Graph. Varve has no node graph and no graph compilation stage.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Align transform cage rectangle rotation with layer bounding box

review.reason: Large UX spec for making the transform cage follow layer space: rotated or skewed bounds, document-space multi-selection bounds, and triangle corner markers. Whether Varve's selection overlay rotates its cage with a rotated node is not established by the packet.
review.varveAssessment: SelectionOverlay and transform-cage geometry.

title: Improve widget layout system to allow updating widgets and groups without resending it all

review.reason: Asks Graphite's widget-layout system to send incremental widget and group updates instead of resending whole layouts. Varve has no transmitted widget layout to make incremental.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Importing image doesn’t work

review.reason: Root cause was a Rust-to-JS serde casing mismatch (`image_data` versus `imageData`) in Graphite's widget payload. Varve decodes imported bitmaps into image nodes through `@varve/import`; there is no equivalent Rust-to-JS image payload contract to mismatch.
review.varveAssessment: Image import path.

title: [Crash Report] Vertical / Horizontal lines cause a crash when dragged

review.reason: The panic came from dividing new by old bounding-box dimensions when old height or width was zero. Varve clamps size fields to a 1px minimum in `PositionSizeSection`, so a zero-area bounds cannot become a scale divisor.
review.varveAssessment: Inspector size fields and transform planning.

title: Exporting in `View Mode: Outline` resulted outlines to be exported

review.reason: Varve has no outline or wireframe view mode; export renders the composited appearance, so a view mode cannot leak into exported output.
review.varveAssessment: Export rendering path.

title: [Crash Report] When loading auto-saved documents, an image in a non-active tab can't find its layer

review.reason: Root cause was that backend messages could only address the active document. Varve keeps each document in per-session state with its own nodes and image data, and recovery points are stored per tab, so an image cannot resolve against another document.
review.varveAssessment: Multi-session autosave restore.

title: Add the Imaginate layer to synthesize images as adjustment layers

review.reason: Adds Graphite's Imaginate (AI image synthesis) layer as a node-graph adjustment type. Varve has adjustment layers but no Imaginate or diffusion layer subsystem.
review.varveAssessment: None; adjustment layers exist, the AI synthesis layer family does not.

title: Rename `/graphene` to `/document-legacy`

review.reason: Directory rename inside Graphite's own repository (`/graphene` to `/document-legacy`).
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: API connecting the frontend with Document Graph

review.reason: Builds the frontend API that connects to Graphite's Document Graph. Varve has no document graph to connect to.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Eyedropper tool frame isn't visible in black/dark background

review.reason: Varve's eyedropper delegates screen sampling to the OS EyeDropper API and otherwise reads canvas pixels directly, drawing no in-canvas sampling frame and announcing each result, so a dark-on-dark sampling frame has no counterpart.
review.varveAssessment: Eyedropper tool.

title: Animation support

review.reason: Varve ships a motion system: timeline keyframes, playback through `MotionFacade`, interpolation and easing, presets, and CSS/Lottie export.
review.varveAssessment: Motion workspace and timeline.

title: Why doesn't the new version run smoothly？

review.reason: Vague performance report about imported SVG documents becoming sluggish when zooming and moving with many layers or anchors; the thread itself only hypothesises overlay-drawing cost and asks for a bisect. No reproducible measurement or Varve counterpart is in the packet.
review.varveAssessment: Canvas render pipeline and overlay drawing would be the area to benchmark.

title: Global shortcut to enter Eyedropper picker state

review.reason: Wants a temporary eyedropper mode entered by a global shortcut without leaving the current tool. That needs the modal/temporary tool-state mechanism Varve lacks (its eyedropper is a full tool switch), which #832 describes.
review.varveAssessment: Blocked on a temporary tool-state layer in `tools/` plus a shortcut entry point.

title: Add a Node Graph adjustment layer type for bitmap compositing

review.reason: Adds a Node Graph layer type so a document graph drives bitmap compositing, initially hardcoded to grayscale or blur. Varve composites with adjustment layers over a fixed scene but has no node graph.
review.varveAssessment: None; the compositing capability exists as adjustment layers with scope.

title: Foundations for GPU-based nodes with RustGPU and WGPU

review.reason: Foundations for GPU-compute nodes with RustGPU and WGPU in Graphite's node graph. Varve's GPU work (ADR-0237) is effect and resample kernels, not a node graph.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Switch to an attribute-based procedural vector format

review.reason: Redesigns the vector document format for arbitrary bezier meshes and Houdini-style procedural operations, which the thread ties to the node-graph roadmap. Varve's scene model is a fixed direct-manipulation node tree with no procedural evaluation.
review.varveAssessment: None; a document-format redesign for procedural data is a separate architecture change.

title: Break handle by clicking newest anchor when drawing segments with Pen tool

review.reason: Varve's path model stores nullable `handleIn`/`handleOut` per anchor and the pen tool adds a segment per click, so clicking the newest anchor starts or breaks a segment rather than re-dragging its handle.
review.varveAssessment: Pen tool and path node model.

title: Toggle sharpness to remove/restore handles by double clicking an anchor point with Path tool

review.reason: Node editing exposes corner, smooth and bend anchor types with nullable handles, and `NodeEditTool` switches handle mode during a drag (Alt sets corner, symmetric preserves the opposite length).
review.varveAssessment: NodeEditTool handle modes.

title: Restore length of handle after releasing Shift for mirroring handle lengths with Path tool

review.reason: Asks that Shift-mirroring during a handle drag be provisional and restore the pre-Shift length on key release. The packet does not show whether Varve's handle drag keeps a snapshot for that restore behaviour.
review.varveAssessment: `NodeEditTool` handle drag and symmetric mode.

title: Handle points should be hidden for sharp points

review.reason: Handles are modelled as nullable pairs (`handleIn`/`handleOut: [x, y] | null`) and `handleLength()` returns 0 for null, so a sharp anchor has no handle point to draw as an overlay circle.
review.varveAssessment: Node-edit overlay and handle model.

title: Allow nudging, angle snapping, and G/R/S transformation of selected points in the Path tool

review.reason: Asks for nudging, axis snapping and G/R/S transforms of selected anchors and handles. Varve's nudge command (`commands/nudge.ts` with `CanvasNudgeController`) only plans whole-node moves, so selected path points cannot be nudged or transformed.
review.varveAssessment: Nudge command and `NodeEditTool` selection need point-level transform support.

title: Double clicking an anchor point with the Path tool only shows one handle near start/end point of path

review.reason: A closed-path edge case where double-clicking the anchor nearest the start/end point restores only one handle. Whether Varve's ring-based path indexing has an equivalent first/last anchor case is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Path ring and handle model in `NodeEditTool`.

title: Crashes due to an auto-loaded document on startup are unrecoverable

review.reason: Varve's recovery layer tolerates corrupt or incompatible recovery data, stays usable when storage is blocked, and writes the clean-shutdown marker only after finalisation so a bad auto-loaded session does not lock the app out.
review.varveAssessment: Recovery and lifecycle startup path.

title: Add modal tool states with the eyedropper, and implement pixel sampling in the color picker popover

review.reason: Introduces modal tool states, a temporary interaction that pre-empts the active tool, and uses the eyedropper as its first case including sampling from the colour-picker popover. Varve's eyedropper is only a full tool switch, so there is no temporary sampling state and no picker-popover sampling.
review.varveAssessment: Tool layer (`BaseTool`/tool manager), shortcut entry, and the colour picker popover.

title: Add multi-stop gradients at user-specifiable percentages

review.reason: Varve's gradient model stores an ordered array of `{position, color}` stops (`packages/scene/src/types.ts`), so gradients are multi-stop at arbitrary percentages.
review.varveAssessment: Gradient model and gradient editor.

title: Improve checkbox styling and visual clarity of other widgets

review.reason: Widgets come from `@varve/ui` components styled by shared tokens and `components.css`, so checkbox styling and widget visual clarity are owned by the design system rather than per-widget CSS.
review.varveAssessment: Shared UI component styles.

title: Build the range slider number input widget

review.reason: Varve composes a range plus numeric input as `RangeValueControl` in the Inspector and `Slider` in `@varve/ui`, over the canonical `.varve-native-range` skin documented in the slider system.
review.varveAssessment: Slider system and Inspector numeric controls.

title: Rendering and interaction CSS issues in Safari

review.reason: Safari-specific UA stylesheet and text-selection workarounds for Graphite's web widgets. Varve's Linux desktop shell runs on WebKitGTK, which shares Safari's engine, so the same UA quirks could apply there, but the packet cannot confirm it.
review.varveAssessment: Shared CSS/widget styles under the WebKitGTK desktop shell.

title: Memory usage spirals out of control as document history grows

review.reason: Varve's undo history is a persistent revision store (an append-only operation-log DAG with snapshots), so growing history does not keep a full document copy, images included, in memory per step.
review.varveAssessment: History and revision storage.

title: Every layer takes at least 8 MB of memory

review.reason: The 8 MB-per-layer reading was the same transient menu allocation later GC'd that closed #849; both reports share that resolution, and no per-layer allocation was found. The layer-count context from this report is retained here.
review.varveAssessment: No equivalent per-layer allocation exists in Varve's scene model.

title: Closing a document does not free memory usage

review.reason: Closed because the retained memory was transient menu allocation awaiting GC, not a leak. Varve has no equivalent per-document menu allocation, and closing a session removes its state and deletes its recovery records (`deleteRecoveryForTab`).
review.varveAssessment: Session teardown and lifecycle.

title: Closing all documents doesn't clear Properties and Layer Tree panels

review.reason: Varve's Inspector and Layers panels read the active session's document and selection, and closing all documents removes the session; there is no node-graph panel that could stay open.
review.varveAssessment: Panels' session-derived state.

title: MVP improvements for the rudimentary node graph

review.reason: MVP work on Graphite's rudimentary node graph: rewiring nodes, re-rendering on topology change, dragging nodes and exposing secondary inputs.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: npm install fails due to cargo build failure

review.reason: The ask is an up-to-date toolchain list plus an informative MSRV failure. Varve documents its confirmed toolchain (Rust, pnpm, Node, just) in AGENTS.md and validates it with `just check-env`.
review.varveAssessment: Developer toolchain documentation and environment check.

title: Linked Artboards as facing pages and folds

review.reason: Wants artboards linked as pages or spreads so resizing one (the book spine) moves the others to keep a fold layout. Varve's document model has `spreads`, `facingPages` and master pages, but linked resize behaviour is not established.
review.varveAssessment: Page/spread model and the Pages panel in the print workspace.

title: Layers physically move when being transferred to a new folder which has a different transform

review.reason: `reparentNode` accepts a `localTransform` that the editor supplies to preserve world position when old and new parents differ, and crossing containers releases a mask whose source left the container.
review.varveAssessment: Layer-panel reparenting and scene node ops.

title: Add support for inpainting and outpainting to Imaginate

review.reason: Extends Imaginate's generative image synthesis with inpainting and outpainting. Varve has no diffusion or generative image subsystem; its AI work is image trace, background removal and upscaling.
review.varveAssessment: None.

title: Add Smoothing to the Freehand Tool

review.reason: `PencilTool` exposes a smoothing setting implemented as a OneEuro stabilizer in `drawingAssists.ts`, wired to `brushSettings.smoothing` for both brush and pencil strokes.
